author: reek
body: Semantics-pinning probe (effect rows stage 0). Nested handlers for the SAME effect: the innermost handler wins and discharges the perform completely (set semantics -- filter-effect removes every occurrence; rows keep this by idempotence). inner-value must be 10, not 99. Must compile and produce identical output today and under rows; if scoped-label semantics ever changes handler nesting, this probe is the tripwire.
